rows.notes: The paper is self-described as a concise review of UAV developments for crop monitoring and pesticide spraying (Abstract, Introduction). It reports no own data, experiment, survey or model runs; Section 3 only sketches a generic quadcopter block diagram and Tables 1-3 compile hardware/software components from cited works. Nothing in the paper concerns multispectral weed detection, targeted herbicide application, or herbicide-use reduction; the claimed 50-80% reduction does not appear anywhere in the text.

notes: Document is a short review/compilation article (The Pharma Innovation Journal, 2023) without primary data; full text appears complete including references.
